items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mahatma Ghandi used Jesus Christ’s Sermon on the Mount and drove the British out of India.

ctx.x: So did you always perform before integrated audiences?

Oh yeah. Sure. So we went. We had the time of our lives, and they had the time of their lives. They loved us. That was the result of it. So it shows, once again, that people create these monsters that they make you afraid of, and that in truth, nothing exists of any power stronger than love. Love is the strongest force in the universe. Mahatma Ghandi used Jesus Christ’s Sermon on the Mount and drove the British out of India. They’ve been trying for a thousand years to do that.
